{{Quote|What do the Dark Lords possibly see in this... scheme to replace soldiers of the Empire with pathetic lawless criminals-|Ganthus|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Ganthus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he was with fellow Moffs [[Sorin]] and [[Talor (Moff)|Talor]] onboard the [[Treasure ship|treasury ship]] [[King's Ransom (treasury ship)|''King's Ransom'']] when it was boarded by a group of thieves including the [[Voidhound]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] found the Moffs conversing in the vaults on the ship, when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harridax Kirill]] opened fire on the ship with the intention to kill everyone on board. Ganthus and other Moffs perished, but the thieves escaped.<ref name="TOR" />
